system.name: Reverse Gravity
system.description:
This spell reverses the pull of gravity on all creatures within a 15' radius of the target point. The creatures will fall upwards for the duration of the spell, falling a maximum of 65'. Then, at the end of the spell's duration, they will fall back to the floor again. There is no save against this spell.

Creatures who hit obstacles on either the upwards or downwards fall take 1d6 damage per 10' fallen.
